verdict.rationale: SumUp documents pairing Solo card readers with a SumUp account and triggering payments on them from a POS via the Cloud API, and Reader SDKs that control a reader over Bluetooth. Virtual Solo lets users test the pairing and checkout flow before switching to a physical reader. Missing for 10: any evidence of the 'within minutes' setup speed, a step-by-step pairing/registration walkthrough for merchant-ops users, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can pair a card reader with the POS app or register it to my account and take a payment within minutes

citations.quote: Pairing multiple Solo card readers with any SumUp account
Trigger and manage payments on Solo or Go readers via HTTPS requests.
Your app controls the reader over Bluetooth or uses Tap to Pay.
